Anthropic CEO says AI backlash is 'fundamentally a crisis of trust'

In a long post on Tuesday, the Anthropic chief executive argued that public distrust of AI labs is not a passing mood but a structural problem the industry has failed to address for three years.

The executive pushed back on the claim that his messaging has been misleading, writing that the company has consistently warned about capability jumps before they happened.

He added that many people outside this bubble think of regulation as something that constrains companies rather than something that gives customers a reason to trust the products they buy.
